packageRules.description: Auto-merge patch and minor devDependency updates after CI passes
Group Biome packages (toolchain moves in lockstep)
TypeScript is a peerDependency declared as >=5.0.0; do not bump the range

typhonjs-escomplex is the complexity kernel for the CRAP/maintainability gates; its resolved version is stamped into committed baselines, so a bump invalidates every baseline. It is pinned at its terminal 0.1.0 (abandonware, but pure-JS and CVE-free) and must only be swapped via a dedicated baseline-recut Epic — never an automated bump. See docs/roadmap.md (Part 1, 'Also parked').
Do not touch the Node engines constraint; it is hand-managed

markdownlint-cli2 is COUPLED to the tree-wide `overrides.js-yaml` pin in package.json (see the `//` note there). npm applies an override ahead of a transitive package's own pin, and markdownlint-cli2 0.23.x declares an exact `js-yaml` 5.2.1 — so an unattended bump across that boundary would silently resolve it onto a js-yaml major it does not support. Exclude it from the devDependency patch/minor auto-merge rule above: the override and the bump must land together, under human review.

DEFERRED — review by 2026-10-31. ajv-formats and string-argv are both effectively unmaintained upstream, but each is a load-bearing runtime dependency shipped in .agents/runtime-deps.json: ajv-formats supplies the `date-time`/`uri` format assertions every schema validator in .agents/scripts/ relies on, and string-argv parses the configured lint/typecheck command lines in .agents/scripts/lint-baseline.js. Neither has a known vulnerability today (`npm audit` clean), so removal is deferred rather than forced: replacing ajv-formats means re-authoring format assertions across every shipped schema, and dropping string-argv means hand-rolling POSIX argv splitting. Updates stay ENABLED so a security release is never blocked, but auto-merge is off so each bump — and the deferral itself — gets a human look. At the review date, re-decide: adopt a maintained replacement, inline the small surface, or extend the deferral with a fresh date.
Major updates always need manual review
GitHub Actions: group all workflow action bumps into one PR
